We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented FP&A Analyst III to support expense analysis, planning, forecasting, and reporting. This individual-contributor role is designed for an experienced finance professional who can independently manage recurring analytical deliverables, work effectively with large datasets, and translate financial results into clear business insights.

The role will partner closely with business stakeholders and finance teams to support expense management, budgeting, allocations, and management reporting. The successful candidate will combine strong financial acumen, technical capability, and a hands-on approach, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and automate recurring FP&A workflows.

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong ownership, accuracy, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to leverage financial systems, data tools, and emerging technologies, including AI, to improve efficiency and insight generation. **This role will require on-site attendance 4 days per week****in Jersey City, NJ.**

Responsibilities:

* Analyze expenses across business units and functions, including actual versus budget, forecast, and prior-period variance analysis; identify and clearly explain key drivers.
* Support annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and long-range planning activities for expenses, including the development and maintenance of allocation methodologies and cost drivers.
* Prepare recurring expense reporting packages, management analyses, and clear presentations for finance and business stakeholders.
* Maintain and enhance financial models, datasets, reports, and dashboards using Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and related tools.
* Work with large, structured datasets; perform reconciliations and validation procedures to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across planning and reporting outputs.
* Support the design, testing, and implementation of expense planning and reporting processes within Oracle or similar enterprise financial systems.
* Partner with business and functional teams to understand expense trends, operating drivers, risks, and opportunities.
* Identify and implement practical improvements to recurring expense reporting, forecasting, and data-preparation processes.
* Use automation and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to enhance financial analysis, reporting quality, and workflow efficiency.
* Maintain clear documentation, controls, assumptions, and audit trails for financial models, allocation processes, and reporting outputs.
* Independently manage assigned deliverables, escalate issues promptly, and meet established reporting and planning deadlines.
* Support ad hoc financial analysis and special projects as needed.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

* Advanced Excel skills, including experience building and maintaining financial models and working with large datasets.
* Proficiency with Power Query and/or Power BI is preferred.

* Exposure to data analytics, automation, or AI-enabled solutions in a finance context is preferred.

* Big Four or similar professional-services experience is a plus.

* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned deliverables, and follow through to completion.
* Hands-on approach with the ability to work in the details while understanding the broader business context.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple deliverables and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive communication and effective cross-functional partnership.
* Intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new systems and tools.

This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports or people-management responsibilities. We are seeking an experienced finance professional to support Bloomberg's Marketing organization, with a primary focus on Advertising & Marketing (A&M) expense management and financial planning.

The role will also have hands-on responsibility for the monthly close process and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of Marketing financial results.

  

The ideal candidate combines strong FP&A experience and financial acumen with attention to detail, an ownership mindset, and strong relationship-building skills. This individual should be equally comfortable managing the details of financial processes and partnering with the business to understand priorities, challenge assumptions, and provide thoughtful financial guidance.

• Own the monthly close process for A&M expenses, including accruals, reclasses, and other adjustments necessary to ensure accurate financial reporting.

• Demonstrated experience partnering directly with business stakeholders to develop budgets, understand spending plans, and manage financial outlooks.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using enterprise financial systems such as SAP, Oracle, EPM, or similar platforms.

  

**Key Attributes**

• Hands-on finance professional with a strong ownership and execution mindset.

• Collaborative business partner who builds effective relationships and credibility with stakeholders.

• Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to identify issues and drive them through resolution.

title: Senior Financial Analyst FP&A – Lifestyle Brands
description:
Overview:

**Catalyst Brands** is seeking a **Senior Financial Analyst** to support financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis for our **Lifestyle Brands** division, namely Aéropostale, Lucky Brand, and Nautica. This hybrid role is based in our **New York, NY** corporate office or our **Lyndhurst, NJ** finance office (preferred).

This position partners directly with Finance, Accounting, and Brand business leaders to evaluate performance across retail, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. You will analyze business drivers, explain financial variances, and deliver actionable insights that shape strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate is an independent, self-starting professional who can own their work from end-to-end. You should blend proficient financial planning and analysis (FP&A) skills with a corporate accounting foundation, possessing an innate curiosity, a meticulous process for validating data, and the ability to translate operational activities into clear, strategic financial narratives.

Responsibilities:

* **Financial Planning & Analysis:** Drive and support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning across retail, e-commerce, wholesale, and corporate operations. We are looking for hands-on partners who actively build and shape forecasts, not just compile reports.
* **Independent Ownership:** Take personal ownership of assigned business areas, forecasts, or recurring deliverables with limited supervision.
* **Analytical Modeling:** Build, maintain, and substantially improve sophisticated, driver-based financial models in Excel with clearly documented, reasonable assumptions that help the business make decisions.
* **Variance & Performance Analysis:** Analyze sales, gross margin, operating expenses (SG&A), and overall profitability against budget, forecast, and prior periods. Proactively investigate unexpected variances, identify underlying root causes, and recommend actionable solutions.
* **Accounting & General Ledger Integrity:** Analyze GL accounts and transaction-level details to validate monthly financial results and explain how accounting activity flows into financial statements. Partner closely with Accounting during month-end close to assess accrual needs and resolve discrepancies.
* **Commercial Analysis:** Partner cross-functionally with non-finance teams to understand operating plans and analyze the impacts of pricing strategies, product volume, category mix, and product costs on sales and gross margin performance across different brand channels.
* **Executive Presentation & Communication:** Partner cross-functionally to prepare and present clear financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations. You must be able to explain complex financial concepts clearly and confidently to both Finance and non-Finance business partners.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 2 or more years of relevant, hands-on experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a combination of corporate accounting and financial analysis.
* **Advanced Excel Capabilities:** High proficiency with advanced Excel features (including lookups, SUMIFS, index/match, pivot tables, and driver-based modeling) with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot formulas.
* **Data Validation & Accuracy:** A structured, rigorous process for self-auditing, reconciling, and checking your own work for accuracy and completeness before presenting results to leadership.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to work productively with non-finance partners to resolve issues and improve forecast accuracy.

**Preferred:**

* **Business Model Knowledge:** Solid working knowledge of retail (brick-and-mortar/e-commerce) and/or wholesale business models, including their unique financial drivers.
* **Industry Experience:** Prior finance or accounting experience within the apparel, footwear, retail, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) sectors.
* **Enterprise Systems:** Experience with enterprise systems and reporting tools, such as Oracle, OneStream, or MicroStrategy.

**What You Get**

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All associates are eligible for an associate discount on Catalyst Brands merchandise. For paid holidays, associates who are eligible for paid vacation (MTO) are also eligible for eight paid holidays during the calendar year. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

Catalyst Brands reflects the bringing together the rich heritages of our brands with modern excitement and a new vision for success. Five iconic brands came together under a unified powerhouse portfolio to celebrate the essence of American style. We will leverage our rich history, resources and best-in-class industry talent to further build the success of our brands. At Catalyst we are united in one shared purpose: We exist to ignite America’s most beloved retail brands to make fashion accessible to all.

Working at Catalyst means joining a dedicated team of associates who are encouraged to be uniquely themselves in a safe, caring and welcoming environment. It is a place where careers prosper, accomplishments are celebrated and diversity flourishes. It’s a place that’s meant for you.

* **Executive Presentation & Communication:** Partner cross-functionally to prepare and present clear financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations. You must be able to explain complex financial concepts clearly and confidently to both Finance and non-Finance business partners.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 2 or more years of relevant, hands-on experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a combination of corporate accounting and financial analysis.
* **Advanced Excel Capabilities:** High proficiency with advanced Excel features (including lookups, SUMIFS, index/match, pivot tables, and driver-based modeling) with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot formulas.
* **Data Validation & Accuracy:** A structured, rigorous process for self-auditing, reconciling, and checking your own work for accuracy and completeness before presenting results to leadership.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to work productively with non-finance partners to resolve issues and improve forecast accuracy.

**Preferred:**

* **Business Model Knowledge:** Solid working knowledge of retail (brick-and-mortar/e-commerce) and/or wholesale business models, including their unique financial drivers.
* **Industry Experience:** Prior finance or accounting experience within the apparel, footwear, retail, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) sectors.
* **Enterprise Systems:** Experience with enterprise systems and reporting tools, such as **Oracle, OneStream, or MicroStrategy**.

**What You Get**

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All associates are eligible for an associate discount on Catalyst Brands merchandise. For paid holidays, associates who are eligible for paid vacation (MTO) are also eligible for eight paid holidays during the calendar year. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

**About Catalyst**

Catalyst Brands reflects the bringing together the rich heritages of our brands with modern excitement and a new vision for success. Five iconic brands came together under a unified powerhouse portfolio to celebrate the essence of American style. We will leverage our rich history, resources and best-in-class industry talent to further build the success of our brands. At Catalyst we are united in one shared purpose: We exist to ignite America’s most beloved retail brands to make fashion accessible to all.

Working at Catalyst means joining a dedicated team of associates who are encouraged to be uniquely themselves in a safe, caring and welcoming environment. It is a place where careers prosper, accomplishments are celebrated and diversity flourishes. It’s a place that’s meant for you.

**About the Role**  
  
Uber is home to one of the largest and most unique claims programs in the world. As our Sr. Claims Manager, Quality & Compliance, you will set the strategy and lead the operating model for claims quality and compliance, spanning First Notice of Loss (FNOL) quality assurance, the Claims Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control environment, audit readiness, and quality and compliance oversight of external claims partners.  
  
You will translate business priorities into a coordinated roadmap with clear ownership, appropriate resourcing, and measurable outcomes. Working with Claims leadership, Operations, Financial Risk Management, Accounting, auditors, and carrier partners, you will build the systems and governance that improve quality, strengthen controls, and address recurring issues at their source.  
  
This role requires a seasoned people leader who combines deep claims expertise with sound business judgment and the ability to lead through ambiguity. You will build and develop a well-rounded team, balance autonomy with coaching, and serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders. Your work will shape how internal teams and external partners deliver consistent, compliant claims experiences and prepare for future business needs.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* Set strategy and priorities. Define and lead the claims quality and compliance roadmap, connecting FNOL quality, control effectiveness, audit readiness, and partner performance to broader Claims and company priorities. Make clear tradeoffs across initiatives and align resources to the highest-impact needs.
* Build and develop the team. Lead a team of claims quality and compliance professionals, define accountabilities, and develop the capabilities needed to deliver the roadmap. Provide thoughtful coaching, delegate with clear expectations, and create a collaborative environment that supports learning, candid feedback, and sustainable performance.
* Design systems that deliver consistent results. Establish governance, decision rights, performance measures, and structured business reviews that align internal teams and external partners around shared objectives. Adjust priorities and capacity as risks, business needs, and performance change.
* Lead the FNOL quality framework. Direct the design and continuous improvement of QA methodologies, sampling approaches, scorecards, calibration, and root-cause analysis. Translate findings into improvements in processes, training, and tooling, and verify that corrective actions produce sustained results.
* Lead Claims SOX control governance. Oversee control matrices, narratives, evidence readiness, and remediation across the Claims control environment. Coordinate control design and testing with control owners, Financial Risk Management, Accounting, and auditors; establish clear accountability for timely deficiency resolution.

description:
**Position Overview**

Siemens Mobility North America seeks an experienced finance leader to head Finance and Performance Management (FPM) for its Rail Infrastructure (RI) business. The role provides an independent, forward-looking view of performance, serves as a trusted sparring partner to RI and Finance leadership, and connects the business unit with North America and global stakeholders.

You will lead the RI FPM team and own the coordination, consolidation, analysis and communication of financial performance, combining strong governance with commercial insight, constructive challenge and pragmatic decision support in a complex project and product environment.

**What You Will Accomplish**

* Drive fact-based performance management, translating financial and operational data into a clear view of results, outlook, risks, opportunities and required actions.
* Act as an independent, solution-oriented partner who challenges assumptions and explains trade-offs without taking over operational ownership.
* Build a coherent RI financial narrative that links drivers, financial statements and management priorities across segments and stakeholders.
* Develop a high-performing, collaborative FPM team that balances business proximity with common North America standards and continuous capability building.
* Advance process harmonization, digitalization, analytics and responsible AI to improve finance quality, speed and productivity.

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Partnership and Performance Management

* Serve as principal FPM partner to RI leadership and the primary RI interface to North America regional and global finance.
* Monitor key financial and operational indicators to spot trends, deviations, risks and opportunities early and turn them into decision-relevant insights.
* Objectively challenge forecasts, budgets, business cases and assumptions; develop scenarios, sensitivities and fact-based recommendations.
* Deliver concise executive analyses explaining what changed, why it matters, what remains uncertain and where action is needed.

Planning, Forecasting, Reporting and Financial Integrity

* Lead the RI annual budget, monthly forecast and management reporting processes, from calendars and inputs through consolidation, review, commentary and submission.
* Ensure a complete, accurate and consistent view of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, with transparent bridges between actuals, forecast, budget and prior outlook.
* Challenge the plausibility of business and project inputs, investigate unusual entries and variances, and make material risks, opportunities and adjustments visible in the outlook.
* Partner with Accounting, Commercial Project Management, Operations and others to align close impacts, assumptions and the financial storyline, while keeping accountability for source data and business decisions clear.
* Escalate material performance, cash, balance-sheet, compliance or control issues promptly, with the evidence decision makers need.

Governance, Process Excellence and Digitalization

* Reinforce finance governance, internal-control and reporting requirements; support audit readiness and documentation of significant assumptions and judgments.
* Clarify responsibilities and interfaces across FPM, the business, Accounting, CPM, Operations and central functions to avoid duplication, ownership gaps and “shadow” controlling structures.
* Drive common North America FPM standards and best practices, allowing fit-for-purpose differences for RI business models and segments.
* Sponsor simplification, automation, analytics and digital-finance initiatives, including SAC, SAP, standardized templates and responsible AI-enabled workflows.
* Regularly assess the value, effort and control implications of recurring reports and processes, prioritizing improvements in insight, reliability or productivity.

Leadership and Talent Development

* Lead, coach and develop a diverse finance team with clear priorities, quality standards, responsibilities and development goals.
* Foster trust, candid communication, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning across locations and organizational boundaries.
* Balance business support, governance and capacity, focusing resources on material topics and ensuring resilient coverage of critical recurring processes.
* Contribute to the North America FPM leadership team and the OneFPM agenda, including talent development, succession planning and cross-business collaboration.

Scope and Accountability

FPM owns financial transparency, process coordination, consolidation, independent challenge and management insight; business and functional owners remain accountable for operational plans, source assumptions, corrective actions and final decisions. The Head of FPM RI keeps these interfaces explicit, surfaces material issues and ensures temporary support does not become a permanent transfer of ownership.

* Coordinate and support investor events including management meetings, company visits, industry conferences, and calls with industry experts and consultants.
* Apply AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance research workflows, streamline data analysis, and improve the quality and efficiency of published research.
* Mentor and support junior team members, contributing to a high-performing research environment through knowledge sharing and day-to-day guidance.

* Hands-on experience applying AI tools or data analytics platforms to investment research or financial analysis workflows.

Portfolio construction sits at the heart of how J.P. Morgan delivers advice to clients, and the Office of Portfolio Construction (OPC) is the firm's strategic engine behind it. We're seeking an energetic, intellectually curious Analyst to join the Portfolio Construction Strategy team — the front-office arm of OPC — to help shape how advisors across the U.S. Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management build, review, and refine client portfolios.

OPC is a major initiative for the business, with a mission to elevate portfolio construction as a core differentiator of the Private Bank and Wealth Management and equip advisors to build portfolios aligned to each client's plan, grounded in our principles, and focused on after-tax outcomes. The group is focused on three pillars — establishing portfolio construction principles, tying strategy to portfolio action, and providing advisors with customized guidance they can scale — and operates across the Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management, supporting 7,000+ advisors and more than $750B in investment assets. Our north star is embedding our advice and methodologies into the AI-powered tools (ConnectWealth and Portfolio Builder) that scale portfolio advice across every advisor.

You'll work alongside senior Strategists and partner closely with Global Investment Strategy, Investments Research, Managed Investments, Due Diligence, and regional Investments & Advice leaders — gaining a broad, cross-asset view of how portfolios actually get built through an after-tax lens at one of the world's leading wealth managers.

**Our Team**

The Portfolio Construction Strategy team is the advisor-facing engine of OPC. We own the firm's portfolio construction philosophy, drive the content and education that bring it to life, and partner with every region and channel across the Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management to drive adoption. Working with a product-agnostic lens — across public and private assets, taxable and tax-exempt portfolios, and discretionary, advisory and brokerage accounts — we help advisors answer the questions that matter most for client portfolios: how to build a strategic asset allocation, how to deliver on client preferences such as high income or concentrated-equity diversification, how to size high-conviction ideas alongside a core portfolio, and how to drive tax-efficiency across the whole portfolio.

**Job Responsibilities**

As an Analyst on the Portfolio Construction Strategy team, you'll work under the guidance of senior Portfolio Construction and Tax-Aware Strategists and the US Head of Portfolio Construction Strategy. * Foundational understanding of taxes and how they influence portfolio decisions — including the impact on asset allocation and asset location — with an interest in deepening tax-aware investing expertise.

About The Job
  
TileBar is an innovative industry leader transforming the tile, interiors and surfaces market in the United States. As a rapidly growing company, we are redefining how homeowners and designers shop for projects. In this role, you will play a vital part in our growth trajectory.
  
The Accounts Payable Manager will be responsible for ensuring the AP department functions effectively as a whole, including managing and training team members, be actively involved in all aspects of vendor management and payment processes including performing various task based obligations, communicate daily with various departments and participate in cash flow and other financial reporting meetings. The role demands ability to work with tight deadlines, high-volume and ability to successfully multi-task while maintaining quality work.
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other minor duties may be assigned.
  

* Manages and supervise the accounts payable department and staff, including both on-site and offshore team members.
* Maintain the AP general ledger, ensures daily AP task are completed by team members, monitors AP inbox and handles any escalated issues
* Perform various daily, weekly and monthly tasks relating to: expense processing and approval, responding to AP requests and questions, be involved in various meetings pertaining to cash disbursement needs,
* Manage vendor accounts ensuring payments are applied properly and timely, vendors are paid within set terms
* Active involvement in weekly cash disbursement meetings with CFO and finance to determine appropriate vendor payments each week
* Prepare weekly cash disbursement runs related to ACH, wires, paper checks, and be actively involved in check run process
* Ensure accuracy of our high volume of invoice data entry and assist with invoice processing of various types of invoices such as: general warehouse and business overhead, marketing spend, and employee travel reimbursements.
* Process all tax-related processes, like the 1099 tax information.
* Provide training to new and existing staff as needed.

Qualifications
  
The requirements listed below are representative of the qualifications necessary to perform the job.
  

* Five or more years of accounting payable experience and 3+ years of experience in a managerial role. (experience in relatable industry or strong understanding of inventory related concepts)
* Has worked in a large enterprise (processing monthly expenses in excess of $5M)
* Detail oriented, able to multitask and meet tight deadlines for monthly reporting requirements
* Ability to manage high-volume transactions and demanding daily, time sensitive requests
* Strong analytical and time management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to be able to communicate daily with the accounting team and other departments as necessary
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, Vlookup, Xlookup, etc.)
* Experience with ERP or accounting software (Great Plains Dynamics 365 or NetSuite preferred)
* Experience with expense software (ie, Concur a plus)

Talent Standards for Success
  
At TileBar, how we work matters as much as what we achieve. In this role, success will also be measured by how consistently you demonstrate TileBar’s five Talent Standards.
  
  
Results Ownership & Accountability
  
Takes ownership of responsibilities and outcomes, communicates proactively, manages commitments and deadlines responsibly, follows through, and addresses risks or issues that may impact results.
  
  
Collaboration & Team Contribution
  
Works well with others, supports team and company goals, shares information appropriately, and builds productive relationships with colleagues, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  
  
Organizational Mindset
  
Understands how individual work, decisions, and priorities affect other people, teams, customers, and the broader company.
  
Balances role-specific responsibilities with what supports the best overall outcome for TileBar.
  
  
Adaptability & Continuous Improvement
  
Adapts to changing priorities, learns new ways of working, remains open to feedback, and looks for opportunities to improve processes, outcomes, and how work gets done.
  
  
Judgment & Problem Solving
  
Uses critical thinking and sound judgment to solve problems, manage priorities, make informed decisions, and know when to act independently, involve others, or escalate.

THE AGENCY
  
The Department of City Planning (DCP) plans for the future of New York City, working to create thriving and dynamic neighborhoods with access to housing and jobs, resilient infrastructure, and a vibrant public realm. The Department engages communities to develop inclusive plans, expands housing access and economic opportunity, and plans for long-term sustainability.
  
  
DCP supports the City Planning Commission in its annual review of hundreds of land use applications. The Department also advises on citywide strategic and capital planning, analyzes data, conducts policy analysis, and creates open data and civic engagement tools. DCP is also the custodian of the official City Map, which designates streets, parks and other public places.
  
  
Department of City Planning offers staff meaningful opportunities to help shape the future of New York City and address some of its most pressing challenges. The Department values public service, collaboration, and creativity, and supports professional development. Learn more about DCP and view current job openings at www.nyc.gov/planning.
  
  
THE DIVISION
  
DCP’s Fiscal Division strives to improve the agency’s financial responsibility and operational effectiveness by providing information, analysis, and administrative and technical support to programs and divisions throughout the agency. The Fiscal team’s daily operations include, but are not limited to, procurement, grant management, accounting for both payments and receivables, budgeting and financial reporting.
  
  
Within DCP’s Fiscal Division, the Procurement Unit oversees the acquisition of goods and services for programs and teams across the agency, ensuring compliance with all applicable rules, laws, and mandates, including but not limited to Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, State and Federal procurement policies, NYC Comptroller Directives, Mayor’s Directives, Department of Citywide Administrative Services’ guidelines, and the City Charter. The Procurement Unit also manages the agency’s existing portfolio of contracts and DCP’s Minority and Women-Owned Enterprise (M/WBE) program.  
  
  
  
THE JOB
  
The Procurement team is seeking to hire a detail-oriented, highly motivated Procurement Analyst. Reporting to the Agency Chief Contracting Officer, the Procurement Analyst will be responsible for processing goods and services requests associated with various procurement methods for divisional needs while adhering to the City's PPB Rules, State and Federal Procurement requirements as applicable, and other Citywide Directives.
  
  
Under the supervision of the Agency Chief Contracting Officer, the selected candidate will be expected to assist the Procurement Division with an array of procurement functions and related tasks including but not limited to:
  
  

* Analyzing incoming procurement requests to determine appropriate procurement methods and reviewing request details for accuracy and adequacy.
* Supporting agency business units to meet purchasing needs efficiently and expeditiously, ensuring purchases are made in adherence with internal and external procurement policies and procedures.
* Working closely with Fiscal and business units to address funding needs for purchases and gathering technical requirements, respectively.
* Utilizing FMS, PASSPort and OCP Portals to process purchases under New York State Requirement Contracts, New York City Requirement Contracts, Punch-Out (DO1) Catalogs, and/or Micro-purchase orders.
* Processing encumbrance increases and decreases as needed to facilitate payment processing and PO closeouts.
* Corresponding with vendors, obtaining quotes, responding to vendor inquiries, and troubleshooting order issues that may arise.
* Processing p-card purchases in compliance with Citywide P-Card Purchasing Policies and Requirements and performing monthly p-card reconciliations and reporting tasks.
* Supporting larger contract processes, such as preparing bid and/or solicitation specifications, facilitating contract registration, etc.
* Performing data entry, maintaining agency procurement trackers and records, and preparing various reports, etc.
* Performing other ad-hoc tasks as assigned.

  
PREFERRED SKILLS:
  
  

* Knowledge of all Procurement Policy Board Rules.
* Knowledge of City systems including FMS, PASSPort, The City Record Online, Checkbook, etc.
* Experience managing procurements from start to completion.
* Ability to adapt to a fluid work environment and changing needs and priorities.
* Strong analytical and negotiation skills.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Effective, clear and persuasive oral and written communications.

When you work with us, you become part of a passionate, collaborative team committed to making a difference in people’s lives. Every initiative, class, and outreach effort we deliver is fueled by a shared commitment to equity and compassion.

Founded in 1902 as a settlement house aimed at supporting New York City's growing immigrant population, Greenwich House has since evolved into a dynamic nonprofit organization dedicated to fostering wellness, creativity, and connection across the city. Today, Greenwich House offers a diverse range of programs in health, human services, education, and the arts, serving thousands of New Yorkers each year. Learn more at *www.greenwichhouse.org*.

**The Opportunity**

The Chief Program Officer (CPO) is a member of the executive leadership team and holds executive accountability for the overall performance, quality, financial sustainability, and strategic direction of all programs operated by Greenwich House and its two affiliates.

Working in close partnership with the Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial and Operating Officer, and Chief External Affairs Officer, the CPO ensures that programs fulfill the organization's mission, meet contractual and regulatory obligations, use resources responsibly, and deliver meaningful outcomes for the communities they serve.

The CPO directly supervises and develops three vice presidents responsible for the organization's diverse program portfolios. The successful candidate will be a strategic and financially astute leader who develops strong leadership teams, promotes collaboration across programs and administrative functions, and balances high expectations with compassion, flexibility, and respect for the people who do this work.

As a member of the executive team, the CPO shares responsibility for the overall success of Greenwich House and its affiliates. The team operates through mutual trust, respect, transparency, and a shared commitment to the mission. Each executive brings distinct expertise and perspective to organizational decisions. Through open dialogue, thoughtful listening, and constructive debate, the team works together to arrive at the best direction for the organization. When a clear direction does not emerge, the CEO makes the final decision, and the executive team supports the resulting course of action. The CPO is expected to prioritize organizational success over individual departmental interests and model this collaborative approach throughout the organization.

*Leadership Development and Performance*

* Coach, mentor, and develop the three vice presidents, strengthening their strategic thinking, financial acumen, decision-making, and leadership effectiveness.
* Establish clear expectations, delegated authority, and accountability while promoting independent judgment, professional growth, and effective succession planning.
* Build a leadership culture grounded in trust, collaboration, constructive feedback, fairness, and compassionate accountability.

*Financial Stewardship and Sustainability*

* Lead annual program budget development and oversee monthly financial performance, working closely with the Chief Financial and Operating Officer and vice presidents to address variances and ensure program sustainability.

description:
**SVP, Business Development (NY, NY)**

Marquee Brands owns and manages a portfolio of global brands across consumer products and channels in Home & Culinary, Luxury, Fashion, and Sports & Active. Our team is committed to driving organic growth through natural brand extensions, impactful marketing and direct consumer engagement. Our promise is to keep our brands’ storied success going through relevant product and expanded distribution, geographic expansion, while staying true to each brand’s founding message and origin.

**Job Summary**

Marquee Brands is looking for a senior business development leader to contribute to and run the company’s new business strategy across its whole brand portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Business Development Officer, the SVP of Business Development will play a key role in executing the licensing growth agenda. They will lead a team of business development professionals, open and close transformational partnerships, and act as a senior face of Marquee Brands to licensees, retailers and industry partners around the world.

The SVP will find and prioritize the highest-value opportunities across brands, categories, channels and geographies, in line with each brand’s DNA and long-term strategy. They will work as a strategic partner to the executive team and to brand, marketing, legal and finance leaders. This person will turn portfolio strategy into a disciplined pipeline that produces revenue and will personally lead the most complex and important deals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Set and carry out the business development strategy across the portfolio, including annual and multi-year revenue targets, category expansion plans and international growth priorities.
* Build, lead, mentor and grow a high-performing business development team (Directors, Managers and Coordinators). Set clear goals, KPIs and accountability.
* Work with executive leadership on portfolio strategy, including evaluating the licensing potential of possible brand acquisitions and building growth plans for newly acquired brands.
* Own business development forecasting and pipeline management.

  

**Growth & Deal Execution**

* Grow revenue across the portfolio by finding, vetting and signing strong licensees in new product categories, channels and territories.
* Personally originate and lead the company’s largest and most strategic deals, including multi-category, multi-territory, direct-to-retail and master license agreements.
* Oversee the full deal process from origination through term-sheet structuring, negotiation and execution. Make sure deal economics, guarantees and partner quality meet company standards.
* Lead complex contract negotiations, working closely with legal counsel and finance.
* Spot new partnership models and revenue streams, such as strategic collaborations, retail partnerships and international distribution.

  

**Relationships & Market Presence**

* Build and keep executive relationships with C-suite decision-makers at top manufacturers, retailers, distributors and international agents.
* Represent Marquee Brands at major industry events, trade shows and conferences (e.g., Licensing Expo, Brand Licensing Europe), and in partner meetings in the U.S. and abroad.
* Show prospective partners clearly how Marquee Brands can help them meet their strategic and financial goals.
* Work with brand and marketing leadership to create compelling, brand-specific pitch materials that match each brand’s value proposition to a partner’s portfolio, capabilities and business model.

  

**Ideal Candidate Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in brand licensing and new business development, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (VP level or above).
* Proven record of originating and closing large, complex licensing agreements, and of consistently meeting or exceeding significant revenue targets.
* Experience building, leading and developing high-performing business development teams.
* Extensive network of senior relationships across licensees, retailers and distribution partners, in both domestic and international markets.
* Deep knowledge of licensee business models, product categories, retail channels, deal structures and international territories.
* Strong experience in Home & Culinary preferred, with exposure to Fashion, Luxury and Sports & Outdoor.
* Strong financial and commercial skills, including comfort with deal modeling, royalty structures and P&L impact.
* Excellent negotiation, communication and executive presentation skills. Able to influence at the C-suite level, both inside and outside the company.
* Strategic thinker with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach, and comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* High degree of ownership, personal accountability and attention to detail.
* Experience supporting brand acquisition diligence or portfolio strategy is a strong plus.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.
* Skilled in CRM systems and Microsoft Office.

Willing to travel domestically and internationally

  

**Marquee Brands Benefits and Perks**

* You'll enjoy coming to work because we have a refreshing company culture that is open, entrepreneurial and fun.

title: Investigator, Compliance & Ethics
description:
**About Nscale**
----------------

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

At Nscale, our Legal & Compliance team plays a critical role in driving business success by partnering with stakeholders to anticipate regulatory change, operationalize compliance requirements, and deliver solutions that protect the company while enabling commercial opportunities, to scale confidently, sustainably, and with integrity.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

You will be a Nscale's dedicated investigator in the United States, mainly handling SpeakUp reports and compliance investigations across our US offices and data centre sites. You will run cases from intake to outcome report, applying US legal requirements and Nscale's global Investigation Standards.  
You will be the local point of contact for Legal, People and site leadership on sensitive matters, and help shape how the programme works as our US footprint grows.

**Key stakeholders**  
US operations and corporate teams  
Legal, including US employment counsels and external counsels  
People team and US People Business Partners  
Finance, Information Security, Data Privacy and Physical Security

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

**Investigations:**

* Lead and conduct investigations into misconduct and compliance concerns.
* Build investigation plans, conduct interviews with reporters, witnesses and subjects, and gather and analyse documents and data.
* Follow Legal guidance on privilege and evidence preservation, including delivering Upjohn warnings where Legal directs.
* Write clear, fact-based investigation outcome reports and recommendations.
* Escalate matters without delay, when required.
* Support other geographies and functions on internal investigations, when required.
* US legal and regulatory considerations
* Knowledge of and demonstrated ability to work with Legal counsel in applying federal and state requirements to case handling, as well as state rules on interview recording and employee monitoring.
* Support anti-retaliation protections under whistleblower laws, where they apply.

**Remediation and Reporting**

* Recommend proportionate disciplinary and corrective actions, and track remediation to completion.
* Carry out post-closure wellness checks with reporters to monitor for retaliation.
* Keep case records complete and audit-ready in the platform, following Nscale standards.

**Programme Support**

* Deliver speak-up and investigations training to managers and internal investigators.
* Suggest improvements to templates, processes and tooling based on case learnings.
* Corporate Compliance programme

As workload permits, you will also support the wider Global Compliance & Ethics programme, including:

* Support the design and delivery of compliance training and awareness campaigns.
* Contribute to compliance programme reviews and risk assessments.
* Support compliance improvement projects.
* Help with compliance monitoring, metrics and reporting, and take on other compliance tasks as needed.

  

**About You**
-------------

* 6-8 years' experience conducting compliance investigations in the US.
* Strong background in investigations practice.
* Strong interviewing skills, including with senior leaders and in sensitive situations.
* Working knowledge of US employment law and investigation practice, including EEO, anti-retaliation and privacy requirements.
* Clear, concise report writing that separates facts from opinion.
* Discretion, impartiality and sound judgement with highly confidential information.
* Ability to manage several cases at once and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

  

**Preferred:**

* Experience with workplace and harassment investigations.
* Certification such as CFE, CCEP or AWI-CH (Association of Workplace Investigators).
* Experience with case management platforms.
* Experience in data centre, construction, infrastructure or high-growth tech environments.
* Additional language skills.

  

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* A collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions will make a real impact.
* A competitive compensation package (base + equity).
* A clear progression plan. We want you to keep growing. That means trying new things, leading others, challenging the status quo and owning your impact. Always with our complete support.
* Flexibility: We see you as individuals first, employees second. This approach includes all the expected perks but goes beyond that to offer true flexibility. We're proud to be a workplace that trusts our Nscalers to excel in their roles while giving you the freedom to shape your day- whether that means fitting in a school drop-off or taking a midday break for a walk with your dog.
* Hybrid Working: Join our hybrid team, and enjoy the flexibility of self-led remote work, allowing you to create a productive and balanced work-life setup, while staying connected with your global team.

  

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

You will connect CLEAR's identity capabilities, real-time travel context, airport operations, member relationships, and partner-enabled services into experiences that are personalized, proactive, and genuinely useful before, during, and after travel. * Experience building production systems with LLMs, agents, evals, or retrieval.
* Experience using engineering metrics such as DORA or SPACE to improve how a team works.
* Background in trade, supply chain, compliance, or working with government customers.

* Identify and test new business lines

* Test new acquisition and distribution channels

* Talk directly with customers and partners
* Take ideas from **hypothesis test results scalable process**
* Build systems and processes where none exist today
* Work directly with the CEO and leadership team on company priorities

This isn’t a traditional sales role, and it isn’t a traditional strategy role. You’ll be expected to **figure out what will move the business forward and then make it happen.**

* Are extremely smart, curious, and resourceful

* Move quickly without needing much structure
* Think analytically but love execution
* Take ownership instead of waiting for direction
* Are comfortable selling, analyzing data, and building a process in the same day

The Senior Affordable Rental Apartments (SARA) Program provides gap financing in the form of low interest loans to support the construction and renovation of affordable housing for seniors, 62+ years in age, with low incomes.

Homeless Housing Strategic Initiatives partners with DHS and other City Agencies on various homeless housing development initiatives including clusters conversion initiative, development of co-located permanent affordable housing with DHS shelters, and other development opportunities.

title: Director of Engineering, Data
description:
**Allara** is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved **health outcomes**. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Allara is hiring its first Director of Data to build the backbone of how the company collects, models, governs, and uses data. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, this is a hands-on leadership role: in your first months you will be in the pipelines yourself, cleaning up our ETL, consolidating duplicated logic, and closing gaps in our source data. Over time you will define and drive the company's longer-term data strategy, set the standards the rest of the organization builds on, and grow the data function as Allara scales. This is a player-coach role, senior enough to own strategy and still happy to get the pipelines right yourself, and the hands-on work comes first.

**Location:** Hybrid (NYC). We value in-person collaboration and aim for at least three days per week in our NYC office, with flexibility as needed.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* Make Allara's data trustworthy, so every team can make decisions on numbers they believe.
* Turn a fragmented, duplicated data setup into one reliable source of truth with traceable lineage.
* Define the data strategy that lets Allara scale its use of data, from AI-assisted analysis across departments and leveraging health data to drive better outcomes.
* Build and lead the data engineering function over time.
* Partner with Product, Growth, Finance, Strategy, and Clinical as the owner of the shared data platform and standards.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**First 6 to 12 months (hands-on)**

* **Clean up the pipelines.** Audit our existing ETL across Fivetran and Mozart into Snowflake, stabilize reliability and freshness, and fix the brittle parts the business has learned to work around.
* **Consolidate duplication.** Collapse duplicated models, metrics, and transformation logic into a single, well-documented modeling layer, so there is one definition of each number rather than several that disagree.
* **Close source-data gaps.** Map what we collect against what the business needs and close the gaps across our systems.
* **Make the data trustworthy.** Stand up data-quality testing, monitoring, and alerting.
* **Establish one source of truth.** Define a canonical metric and semantic layer

**Ongoing (strategy and ownership)**

* **Own the data strategy.** Shape how Allara collects, models, governs, and uses data as the company scales, and advises leadership on tooling, investments, and build-versus-buy decisions.
* **Own governance and compliance.** Own data governance, access control, and PHI and PII handling appropriate for a HIPAA-covered healthcare environment.
* **Own the shared platform.** Serve departmental stakeholders and data analysts, as the owner of the platform and standards they build on, and enable trustworthy self-serve analytics.
* **Own AI-ready data.** Own the shared, AI-ready data layer and the canonical terminology definitions and skills that power AI-assisted analysis across departments.
* **Build the team.** Hire, mentor, and lead the data engineering function over time, setting the technical bar and the practices the team works by.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering, including direct, recent ownership of production ETL and warehouse modeling.
* Strong SQL and a cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred), ETL tooling, and a transformation and modeling layer.
* A proven track record of taking over brittle, duplicated, or undocumented pipelines and turning them into reliable, documented, trusted data.
* Strong data modeling fundamentals and a real bias toward a single source of truth.
* Experience designing data governance and handling sensitive data, with comfort around security and access control in a regulated environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Healthcare or HIPAA experience, including familiarity with EMR data (FHIR) and claims.
* Experience with D2C growth metrics
* Experience with Amplitude and product event taxonomy, and enabling AI or LLM-assisted analytics such as semantic layers, metric catalogs, or Claude skills.
* Experience building and managing a data team at a high-growth startup (Series B to D).

*Having these would be advantageous over candidates lacking these qualifications and would potentially allow the candidate to have a greater and/or more immediate impact on the role.*

**What Allara Offers**

**Compensation & Career Growth**

* $220,000-$250,000 with opportunities for advancement
* Equity
* Professional development & employee learning programs

*Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to: candidate experience, location, education, certifications, and skill set. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes equity, comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision), generous paid time off, and additional wellness and professional development perks.*

**Work Environment & Flexibility**

* 100% remote within the U.S./or 3-day hybrid in NYC
* Unlimited PTO & 11 company holidays/ or L1 offerings

**Health & Wellness**

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Long- and short-term disability coverage
* Annual employee wellness stipend

**Family & Future Planning**

* 401(k) plan
* Parental leave & family planning support benefits

**Additional Perks**

* Company-issued laptop
* Annual work-from-home stipend
* Commuter benefits (if applicable)
* A collaborative, mission-driven culture focused on improving patient care

At **Allara**, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

We’re looking for a Digital Business Analyst to help turn customer and business needs into measurable digital outcomes.

You’ll work across product, technology, design, data, operations, and business teams to identify opportunities, define priorities, and deliver improvements to our digital platforms. This role goes beyond documenting requirements: you’ll help ensure that what we build solves the right problem, improves the user experience, and delivers meaningful value.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with a practical understanding of digital products, customer journeys, agile delivery, and performance measurement.

Key responsibilities

Define digital opportunities

* Partner with stakeholders to understand customer, colleague, and business needs.
* Analyze user behavior, feedback, operational data, and market trends to identify opportunities.
* Translate complex problems into clear, outcome-focused goals.
* Support prioritization based on customer value, business impact, risk, effort, and strategic alignment.

Shape products and experiences

* Map current and future-state customer journeys, processes, and service experiences.
* Identify friction, duplication, failure points, and opportunities for simplification.
* Develop clear business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and supporting documentation.
* Work with product managers, technology teams and subject matter experts to evaluate solution options.
* Ensure requirements remain focused on the intended outcome rather than simply reproducing existing processes.
* Support accessibility, usability, security, resilience, data, and compliance considerations throughout delivery.

Enable effective delivery

* Participate in discovery, planning, refinement, sprint reviews, **testing**, and retrospectives.
* Clarify requirements and resolve questions quickly during delivery.
* Help teams make informed trade-offs when scope, time, cost, or technical constraints change.
* Coordinate dependencies across platforms, products, and business areas.
* Support user acceptance testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.
* Maintain traceability between needs, requirements, delivered capabilities, and expected outcomes.

Measure and improve results

* Define key performance indicators and outcome measures with product and business stakeholders.
* Establish baseline measures and support benefits tracking after launch.
* Analyze whether changes improve customer experience, adoption, conversion, efficiency, quality, or other agreed objectives.
* Use data and feedback to recommend iteration and continuous improvement.
* Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you’ll bring

Required experience and skills

* Experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Digital Analyst, Product Owner, or similar role in a digital environment.
* Experience working on customer-facing websites, mobile applications, digital platforms, or internal digital products.
* Strong understanding of digital product delivery and agile ways of working.
* Ability to translate business and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements.
* Experience with customer journey mapping, process analysis, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use qualitative and quantitative information.
* Experience defining or tracking product metrics, KPIs, or business outcomes.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, and drive decisions to closure.
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader customer and business objective.

Preferred experience

* Experience in financial services, banking, payments, insurance, or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with digital analytics tools, dashboards, experimentation, or customer feedback platforms.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, data flows, or platform capabilities.
* Understanding of accessibility, privacy, security, risk, and regulatory considerations.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed organization with distributed teams.
* Relevant business analysis, agile, product, or process-improvement certification.

What success looks like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will:

* Help teams define clearer outcomes before work enters delivery.
* Improve the quality and consistency of requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Surface customer and operational pain points that lead to actionable improvements.
* Strengthen alignment among business, product, design, technology, and control teams.
* Support the delivery of digital changes that can be measured after launch.
* Help reduce avoidable rework by identifying dependencies, risks, and unanswered questions earlier.

Working style

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

* Start with the customer or user problem, not the preferred solution.
* Focus conversations on outcomes, evidence, and trade-offs.
* Bring structure to ambiguity without creating unnecessary process.
* Collaborate openly and value different perspectives.
* Take ownership of decisions, follow-through, and measurable results.
* Communicate with clarity and adapt your style for different audiences.
* Balance pace with responsible delivery in a regulated environment.

**About ASCAP**

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

**Job Overview:**

The TV Analyst is responsible for assisting both the TV Team Leader and other TV Distribution team members with the processing of audio and visual programming, sharing in the overall responsibility of ensuring that ASCAP members are properly credited for the performance of their works in audio/visual media.

Successful completion of these efforts requires the careful analysis of television performance, promo, and cue sheet data. TV Analysts will associate programs and promos with performances, verify the accuracy of any data provided, procure and upload any missing data, identify and reconcile discrepancies, and participate in quality assurance procedures to ensure that ASCAP members are accurately paid. This is a hybrid position with currently a minimum 1 day per week in-office requirement.

* Identify and match cue sheets to performances.
* Request missing or incomplete cue sheets from suppliers.
* Upload missing performances to the performance database.
* Reconcile the station count and any informational discrepancies within performance data.
* Verify cue sheet content.
* Assign and create work records for cues.
* Control check work records and performances that have been matched by 3rd party vendors.
* Integrate music video programming into distribution.
* Assist with the timely resolution of member-initiated inquiries.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

### **WMS Software Engineer**

***This position is hybrid to either our Newark, NJ or New York City sites***

***Come see what's cookin' at HelloFresh!***

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering our customers high quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Over the past 10 years, we've seen this mission spread around the world and beyond our wildest dreams. Now, we are a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit company, active in 19 countries across 3 continents.

So, how did we do it? Our weekly boxes full of exciting recipes and fresh ingredients have blossomed into a community of customers looking for delicious, healthy and sustainable options. The HelloFresh Group now includes our core brand, HelloFresh, as well as: GreenChef, EveryPlate, Chef's Plate, Factor, and Youfoodz.

**Job Description:**

This position will report to the Technical Lead and work on developing solutions and integrations for our strategic warehouse management system (The Körber Warehouse Advantage/ HighJump Platform) via Webwise Page Editor, Advantage Architect and SQL. This position is preferred to be seated and eligible for hybrid work office policy in one of the following fulfillment/ office locations: Warsaw, Poland| New York, NY|Toronto, Canada| Boulder, CO| Aurora, IL| Newark, NJ | Irving, TX |Goodyear, AZ| Phoenix, AZ.

**You will…**

* Write and update SQL procedures, views, and host tables that support warehouse workflows such as receiving, replenishment, WIP management, and shipping.
* Develop solutions to specifications on time,within budget and with a high degree of quality and precision to specification.
* Support integrations between the WMS and upstream and downstream systems, including production technology, ERP, and Kafka-based messaging.
* Document technical changes and procedures so warehouse teams can use new functionality without extra help.
* Work closely with team colleagues in an Agile environment, participating in sprint planning, daily scrums, backlog grooming, and other Agile ceremonies
* Prepare and clearly communicate best in class methods by which HelloFresh Operations can effectively utilize the enhancements developed.
* Document and deliver all required materials to support software change control
* Partner with the HelloFresh WMS support analyst team to triage/ troubleshoot/ resolve complex technical issues or system defects efficiently in order to minimize impact on operations users and/or project timelines

**You are…**

* Able to multitask and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment
* Someone with an analytical mindset and who is passionate about efficiency
* Detail oriented with relentless follow up
* An excellent oral and written communicator and have a team player mentality
* Someone with both technical development proficiency as well as strong operational supply chain process knowledge
* Excellent Problem Solving and debugging skills.
* Able to work independently and as part of a team.
* Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership.
* Able to learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements.

**You have…**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–3 years of software development, systems support, or technical analyst experience, ideally in supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing, preferably WMS
* Working knowledge of SQL, including writing queries, stored procedures, and basic data modeling.
* Familiarity with GitHub pull requests and interpret YAML-based GitHub Actions workflows to diagnose and fix failed deployment checks.
* Understanding of AWS core services will be preferred.
* Familiarity with warehouse management concepts such as inventory locations, LPNs, replenishment, and cycle counts.
* Experience with a scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, or C#.
* Comfort with ticketing and collaboration tools such as JIRA and Slack.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical operations teams.
* Preferred: prior experience with Infios, HighJump, Körber, or another enterprise WMS, and exposure to message queues or event streaming such as Kafka.0-2 years of Koerber/ HighJump design and development experience with Advantage Architect, Advantage Link, Webwise Page Editor
* Experience with Bartender and Label Design a plus
* Industry experience in food/ cold chain a plus
* As part of a global organization, the individual work hours flexibility and reliability to occasionally work with peers and leadership across multiple time zones
* Willingness and ability to travel to different HelloFresh facilities as needed in support of projects or platform rollouts or to collaborate with peers.

**You'll get…**

  

* 401k with company match that vest immediately upon participation, and company equity plan based on role
* Generous PTO and parental leave of up to 16 weeks
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
* Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)
* Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor\_)
* Access to 7 different Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) including those for BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
* Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

**About HelloFresh....**

We believe that sharing a meal brings people of all identities, backgrounds, and cultures together. We are committed to celebrating all dimensions of diversity in the workplace equally and ensuring that everyone feels a sense of inclusion and belonging. We also aim to extend this commitment to the partners we work with and the communities we serve. We are constantly listening, learning, and evolving to deliver on these principles. We are proud of our collaborative culture. Our diverse employee population enables us to connect with our customers and turn their feedback into meaningful action from developing new recipes to constantly improving our process of getting dinner to our customers' homes. Our culture attracts top talent with shared values and forms the foundation for a great place to work!

  

At HelloFresh, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. As part of the Company's commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable accommodations, up to the point of undue hardship, to candidates at any stage, including to individuals with disabilities.

The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.

**About the role**
==================

We started Chaffin Luhana in January 2010 because we wanted to build a firm where our actions match our values. Since then, our attorneys have recovered more than $1 billion for injured people, and state and federal judges have appointed us to lead national product liability litigation. Our ethos is Doing Good by Doing Right™.  
We are looking for a full-time COO to join us as the senior-most business leader in the firm. We run on EOS, and you will serve as our Integrator, reporting directly to the two founding partners.  
Here is the honest context. We built this firm’s operations ourselves, and the firm has outgrown the way we built them. We have strong department leaders, a growing brand, and some very good years in front of us. What we don't have is one person who is fully engaged in driving the business forward: someone who identifies the priorities, brings us recommendations, and gets the team executing without either founder having to keep pushing things along (or getting in the way). Everything else in this description is detail. That is the job.  
  
**Why Be the COO at Chaffin Luhana?**  
**Run the business.** You will run the whole business, not a slice of it. Marketing, intake, client experience, finance, people, and technology all report through this seat, and you will work directly with the two founders on where the firm goes next.  
**Help shape what comes next.** AI, management services organizations (MSOs), and changing client expectations are creating new choices for law firms. Help us evaluate those choices and remain competitive while staying true to our ethos. We want your judgment about where to invest, what to change, and what to protect.  
**The timing is genuinely good.** We have significant litigation maturing over the next few years and the resources to invest ahead of it. This is a role for a growing firm that needs a real operator at the wheel.  
**You will build, not maintain.** Our reporting and analytics are partially built, and finishing that work is yours to own and design. A year from now, the way this firm makes decisions should reflect how you decided it should work.  
**The mission is real.** We describe ourselves as data driven but heart led. Our clients come to us during the darkest time in their lives, and we believe one of our strongest differentiators is the compassion we have across the team. We hire by our values, promote by them, and have parted ways with talented people over them.  
**We have staying power.** Mass torts and contingency work run on long business cycles, and plenty of firms don't last. We've been doing this for fifteen years, we've grown through the hard parts, and it's been worth the push.  
**Help people become their best.** We want our team members to grow professionally and personally, become exceptional colleagues and leaders, and give clients an incredible experience. Strong operations should help our attorneys and team deliver outstanding litigation and trial results. Compassion, high standards, and accountability belong together here.
